methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from official manufacturer spec pages (dji.com/us/osmo-action-5-pro/specs, dji.com/us/osmo-action-4/specs) and corroborated via independent review sites (digitalcameraworld.com, expertreviews.co.uk). Prices are US MSRP / current retail for base/standard-bundle configuration as noted in priceNote; prices verified via Newegg and Insta360 store June 2026. GoPro website returned HTTP 403; GoPro specs drawn from Wikipedia GoPro article (cross-checked with manufacturer-known specs) and digitalcameraworld.com review. Sony RX0 II is discontinued; specs from Sony published materials and industry knowledge of the DSC-RX0M2. max_video is the highest-resolution, highest-frame-rate video mode string achievable on the camera body without external accessories. sensor is the CMOS sensor size designation as stated by manufacturer. stabilization is the brand/technology name for the primary electronic or optical image stabilization. waterproof_m is the body-only waterproof depth rating in meters (no additional housing). display is a brief description of screen(s) (size, type). fov_deg is the maximum native field of view in degrees (widest standard lens mode, without add-on accessories; null if only stated as 360 for spherical cameras). weight_g is body weight including battery in grams as stated by manufacturer. release is YYYY-MM of first commercial availability. Null is used only for genuinely unknown values. All sources accessedAt 2026-06-15.
